optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Operations Process Specialist, Equipment Maintenance Services
professionalSummary: Managed work-order intake and scheduling for two regional service teams, assigning planned maintenance and breakdown jobs to technicians and re-sequencing days when a breakdown occurred. (src_230569817cae)
Maintained the parts-request checklist used by dispatchers, adding a step to confirm depot stock for the top twenty part numbers. (src_4e0f85619b8f)
Coordinated parts availability with three regional depots via phone and daily depot stock reports; approved stock transfers with depot supervisors. (src_52e66e0abc78)
Authored weekly scheduling hand-over documents for incoming dispatchers, listing open work orders, parts on order, and jobs requiring a second visit. (src_bd8c27f621b2)

Held responsibilities for work-order intake, scheduling, parts-request checklist maintenance, and depot coordination for approximately eighteen months in the maintenance services division. (src_753f3f9eec3d)
experienceHighlights: Ran work-order intake and scheduling for two regional service teams in the field-service system, assigning planned maintenance and breakdown jobs to technicians and re-sequencing the day when a breakdown came in. (src_230569817cae)
Maintained the parts-request checklist that dispatchers complete before a visit is confirmed, adding a step to confirm depot stock for the top twenty part numbers. (src_4e0f85619b8f)

Coordinated parts availability with the three regional depots by phone and the depot stock report each morning; stock transfers between depots were approved by the depot supervisors. (src_52e66e0abc78)
Wrote the weekly scheduling hand-over for the incoming dispatcher, listing open work orders, parts still on order and jobs that needed a second visit. (src_bd8c27f621b2)
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: the parts-request checklist with the depot-stock step and one weekly scheduling hand-over listing open work orders and parts on order, with the field-service system's work-order numbers as a verification trail. (src_88f061211b11)
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided materials establish the candidate’s experience with work-order intake and scheduling, parts-request checklist maintenance, depot coordination, and scheduling hand-over documentation, but do not provide quantitative evidence of a measured reduction in repeat visits or explicit documentation of limitations and hand-over conditions beyond the weekly hand-over.

evidence.text: Ran work-order intake and scheduling for two regional service teams in the field-service system, assigning planned maintenance and breakdown jobs to technicians and re-sequencing the day when a breakdown came in.
Maintained the parts-request checklist that dispatchers complete before a visit is confirmed, adding a step to confirm depot stock for the top twenty part numbers.

Reference call with former dispatch supervisor: said the checklist change 'made a real difference' and that repeat visits 'went down a lot, maybe by a third'; she could not recall whether anyone had measured it and said the division did not track repeat-visit reasons at the time.
